verified_contracts.detail: Schema2 is accepted only for at most two-case preview under ignored outputs/research. Full publication refuses running/partial/failed receipts.

verified_contracts.claim: Schema3 uses shared native worker receipt validator and binds all three SHA/bytes records plus retained-file membership.
verified_contracts.detail: sim2sim_scene_matrix.validate_worker_receipts enforces supervisor2/entry1, source hash, faulthandler, ordered two workers, unique spawn/entry/completion/final events, signed zeros, exact native entry argv/output/birth, known native membership and observed group identity, retired empty groups, intact ownership, and no cleanup/errors/kill events.

verified_contracts.claim: All listed prior attempts are retained without status filtering.
verified_contracts.detail: Sealed histories verify every original file/identity/execution; unsealed histories explicitly label current fingerprints only. Duplicate attempts and otherwise unrecorded nested attempt directories are refused. Copy stage retains all files and parent logs; root race fix preserves sealed expectations.

verified_contracts.claim: Original evidence stays read-only and publication is staged into a separate empty output.
verified_contracts.detail: Output cannot be inside raw matrix/driver-receipt directories; nonempty destinations refused; copies compare source before/after and destination SHA; exceptions clean only the new staging directory. Full plan/matrix/receipt bytes are rechecked before rename.

old_five_boundary.claim: Original failed directories and parent logs remain present; publisher does not edit/remove inputs.
old_five_boundary.important_scope: A new schema3 cohort is separate from the abandoned legacy cohort. It does not automatically merge those five foreign-plan attempts into fresh cases; retain/link their existing halt/forensic audit as historical evidence. Every attempt actually listed in a published case is copied.

limits: Current publisher result is infrastructure verification only, not complete629 physical coverage or SDK018 acceptance.
Explicit expected hashes must be independently obtained from the reviewed frozen new cohort; choosing arbitrary matching caller values is not independent provenance.

Legacy preview still requires retained original input/dependency bytes at the mapped paths. A changed current source tree can legitimately fail that old hash gate; do not mislabel it as an environment fault.
An unsealed historical attempt can only preserve currently available bytes; this does not retroactively prove its shutdown or reconstruct missing files.
The initial 33-test JUnit and initial race proof are historical; current acceptance is the final34-test JUnit plus fixed reproduction.
Original five media were only listed by existence, not re-decoded/rehash-verified by this read-only source review.
